clips.title: The story
paras: Sentinel Thenysil sends you from Astranaar to Darnassus for an audience with Tyrande Whisperwind. After you help the Sentinels hold their ground against the Venture Company in Stonetalon, Tyrande receives you at the Temple of the Moon.

The Venture Company puts pressure on night elf outposts across the Stonetalon Mountains. Sentinel Thenysil coordinates the defense from Astranaar, but the remote bases are hard to sustain. Supply lines and intelligence help the Sentinels keep an Alliance presence in Kalimdor's interior, and your aid strengthens their position.

After your help bolsters the Sentinels in Stonetalon, Sentinel Thenysil sends you back to Teldrassil. Tyrande Whisperwind, the High Priestess, grants you an audience at the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus. She recognizes your deeds across Kalimdor and welcomes you as an ally fighting alongside the kaldorei.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend, I am sure Tyrande Whisperwind herself would like to thank you for taking part in this mission.
It may not appear so on the surface, but what you've helped start could very well strengthen our foothold in the Stonetalon Mountains.
If you consider yourself our ally against these atrocities, go see Tyrande in the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hello, friend. I have indeed heard your name before, and although you are still full of youth, I am pleased to see the path you have set for yourself.
You would do me a great honor if you would accept this as a gift of appreciation.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
